Staff Portal

Need something fixed, ordered, or booked?

One form covers facilities, supplies, tech, Montessori materials, and everything else you need to do your job well.

Open the request form Opens in a new tab. Takes about two minutes.

How a request moves

  1. 1

    Describe it

    Pick a category, say where it is, and add a photo if it helps. Two minutes, tops.

  2. 2

    The office triages

    The front office reviews new requests and sorts them by priority. Urgent items go first.

  3. 3

    You hear back

    The office follows up with what is happening and when. If it has gone quiet, nudge us.

Dangerous or blocking class right now?

Don't wait on the form. Call the front office first, then log it so there is a record.

(510) 817-4690

What you can request

Every tile opens the same form. Pick the closest match and the office will route it.

  • Facilities & Maintenance Broken/damaged items, lighting, plumbing, HVAC, cleaning
  • Classroom Supplies Paper, art supplies, consumables, books
  • Technology Support Chromebooks, printers, WiFi, accounts
  • Montessori Materials Sensorial, practical life, language, math materials
  • Plants & Classroom Pets Plant supplies, soil, classroom pet food/bedding
  • Curriculum & Books Book orders, lesson materials, field trip requests
  • HR / Administrative PTO, substitute requests, payroll questions
  • Room Booking Reserve classroom, gym, outdoor space
  • Other Anything else not covered above

Before you hit submit

  • Say exactly where. Classroom name and campus. "The sink" is not enough when there are five.
  • Attach a photo. For facilities and tech it usually saves a follow-up visit.
  • Set an honest priority. Marking everything urgent makes the truly urgent things wait.
